title: Skill-quality, compare, loop and budget thresholds
description: data-pack/quality/thresholds.json — the shared judgement numbers that used to be hand-written literals in packages/shared (RM-38 WP 2.2). Unlike advisor/thresholds.json these values ALSO have a compiled floor, because apps/web reads several of them and packages/shared may not touch the filesystem: `pnpm build:data-pack` renders them into packages/shared/src/pack-defaults.generated.ts, so there is exactly one AUTHORED copy (this file) and the compiled one is derived. The two skill-quality ceilings resolve env → pack → compiled default. Judgements, not dated facts, so no `as_of`.

skill_quality_l1_token_ceiling.description: Skill IDE quality engine — L1 (metadata) token ceiling above which an `l1-budget` warning is raised. Overridable per-install by SKILL_QUALITY_L1_TOKEN_CEILING.

skill_quality_l2_token_ceiling.description: The same for L2 (body). Overridable by SKILL_QUALITY_L2_TOKEN_CEILING.

quality_severity_weights.description: The ONLY definition of the quality score's penalty per severity: score = clamp(100 - sum of weights, 0, 100).

default_compare_threshold.description: The Jaccard floor the compare matcher uses when a caller passes none (GET /api/compare, the assertions gate, the fleet report, skill-IDE tool validation).

default_loop_threshold.description: SkillFlow trace aligner — visit-count ceiling for generic loop detection.

failure_bucket_score_threshold.description: Suite failure buckets — a run scoring below this is a low-score candidate.

workbench_mcp_definition_token_budget.description: D-MCP5 — the token budget the workbench's OWN MCP mount holds its serialized tools/list payload under. `pnpm mcp:self-scan` fails over it.
